landing.headline: A solid foundation for <molten>forging</molten> applications
landing.sub: A production-ready NestJS microservices starter with DDD, CQRS, event-driven messaging, full observability, and one-command deploys. Everything is wired up so you build instead of setting up.

architecture.title: Strong architectural patterns
architecture.desc: Hexagonal architecture, DDD and CQRS shape every service. The structure is already there, and lint rules fail the build when someone breaks it.

events.title: Uncoupled and ready to scale
events.desc: Services never call each other directly. They publish events to Kafka through a transactional outbox, so each part scales and fails on its own without losing a message.

observability.title: Built-in monitoring
observability.desc: Endpoints, commands, queries, events: everything ships metrics, traces and logs into Grafana. There is nothing to instrument by hand.

auth.title: Auth is already done
auth.desc: Email and Google sign-in, email verification, password resets and roles. A complete account system before you write any code.

agents.title: A codebase AI agents can navigate
agents.desc: Strict structure and naming mean every feature reads the same. A coding agent, or a new teammate, finds the right file on the first try.

testing.title: Tests that run in seconds
testing.desc: Every handler comes with unit tests running against in-memory adapters. The whole suite finishes in seconds, with no containers and no database.
